class Holder<Out = string> { constructor(public value: Out) {} }
class DefaultHolder extends Holder {}
const notNumber: number = new DefaultHolder("x").value;
class LiteralHolder extends Holder<"lit"> {}
new LiteralHolder(1);
class Cell<T = number> { item!: T; read(): T { return this.item; } }
class DefaultCell extends Cell {}
const notString: string = new DefaultCell().read();
class TextCell extends Cell<string> {}
const notCount: number = new TextCell().item;
class ListCell<U> extends Cell<U[]> {}
new ListCell<number>().read().push("a");
const wrongBase: Cell<number> = new TextCell();
type IsNumberCell = DefaultCell extends Cell<string> ? true : false;
const isNumberCell: IsNumberCell = true;
class Reader extends Cell<boolean> { flag(): number { return this.item; } }
